description: This file defines a custom exception class `AcknowledgementRequestParseException` used for representing errors during the parsing of acknowledgment requests in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class extends `DittoRuntimeException` and provides methods for constructing the exception from error details or JSON representations, including contextual information such as headers and causes.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequestParseException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating failure to parse an acknowledgment request from a string or JSON. It is immutable, thread-safe, and provides multiple constructors for error creation, including from JSON objects.

methods.name: AcknowledgementRequestParseException (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the exception with headers, message, description, cause, and an optional URI reference.

methods.name: getMessageIncludingCause
methods.description: Generates an error message including the cause's message if present.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
